candidates.title: Island Goes Dark to Save Baby Seabirds
candidates.description: Corvo Island in the Azores turns off all public lighting for five nights each autumn, helping fledgling Cory’s shearwaters navigate by starlight to the ocean without getting disoriented.

candidates.title: Anthropic Files for Record-Breaking $1.5 Trillion IPO
candidates.description: The AI company behind Claude is preparing for one of the largest stock market debuts in history, testing the financial viability of the booming artificial intelligence sector.

candidates.title: Hunter's Moon Captivates Photographers Worldwide
candidates.description: Stunning images from around the globe showcase October's full Hunter's Moon, lighting up night skies and inspiring amateur astronomers and photographers alike.

candidates.title: Dictionary.com Names 'Maxxing' Word of the Year
candidates.description: The suffix '-maxxing', used to describe optimizing every aspect of life, has been chosen as the word of the year, reflecting a cultural shift toward self-improvement and digital trends.

candidates.title: Bayeux Tapestry Beats Hollywood for Young Audiences
candidates.description: Data reveals that young Britons are more eager to see the 1,000-year-old embroidery exhibition than top film blockbusters, marking a surprising pop culture moment for medieval art.

candidates.title: OpenAI Announces Major Science Discoveries
candidates.description: Less than a month after releasing math solutions, OpenAI unveils three new major discoveries in computer science and physics, collaborating with external experts to guide the results.
